In my day-to-day life, both at work and outside it, I write less and less. In fact, it was only recently that I picked up a notebook to write down whatever comes up, after watching [this video](https://youtu.be/4Nq99I4ySqw). It's an experiment I have going. The first week I wrote every day about anything, relevant things that came up during the day. Last week I wrote once. Which I don't think is bad either, since in the end the idea isn't to force myself to write. It's more about having the notebook at hand for when something comes up, and also being able to read back over things I've written before.

Along the same lines, I felt like occasionally taking topics, movies/series, situations, and turning them over, trying to go a bit beyond my first thought. Writing it down and keeping those ideas here. Obviously without using AI for the writing, since that wouldn't make sense. So it will probably happen often that I end up getting tangled up in my ideas, and the writing/coherence won't be the best. Either way, I'm going to give it my best shot.
